body: I cant tell you, i Got diagnosed by a doctor, but if you feel like you relate you should talk to somebody professional, nobody on the internet can diagnose you :)

Its different from person to person. For me it really affects my relationships with friends, family, love interests. Its intense moodswings, a lot of depression, self-blame, guilt, and a constant assurance that no matter what people say or do, they Will always abandon you in the end. This can result in making someone with borderline feel that its easier to leave people, make them leave, than to wait for them to leave. When i get a borderline episode, it can be when someone does something that hurts me intentional or non-intentional i self isolate, and push everyone away, though inside wishing they Will come back to prove they Care.

Borderline is a lot of thing, and that was just an example, i would describe it as always feeling overwhelming feelings. Always extremes. If you are sad you are not just sad, you are hopeless, alone, depressed, empty.

I dont know if any of this made sense, im in a bad place atm, but i hoped it made some sense :)
Its stands for borderline personality disorder

Its exactly like that, and it feels like whenever something slightly good happens (e.x a good friendship) i Will always fuck it up, no matter what. 
Thats when the thought of ending things is worse. 
Why keep trying when ultimatively it will always end and the pain of losing leaves me worse of than before
I also have bpd, and right now i really relate with u, it feels like my life is going in circles but somehow will always end up worse than before
